# Vloam Labs

> Independent software & privacy research studio building native desktop utilities and ephemeral client-side web tools.

Vloam Labs is an independent engineering collective dedicated to local-first computation, zero-telemetry software design, and client-side ephemeral sandboxing. All desktop applications operate strictly on-device without cloud sync dependencies, while online self-assessment tools execute all logic exclusively within the visitor's local browser memory.

## Software & Tools Matrix

- [VloamDb](https://db.vloam.com/): Fast, lightweight, keyboard-first native MySQL client for developers on macOS and Windows. Features production safety locks, environment color tags, instant table fuzzy search, and hardware-backed local credential storage (macOS Keychain & Windows DPAPI).
- [VloamClip](https://clip.vloam.com/): Local-first desktop clipboard utility for macOS and Windows. Features FIFO/LIFO sequential multi-paste queues, persistent template categories, encrypted on-device SQLite storage, and sub-millisecond history search.
- [Vloam Mermaid](https://mermaid.vloam.com/): Real-time interactive in-browser Mermaid diagram visualizer and editor. Instant split-pane preview, lossless SVG and high-resolution PNG export, and zero-telemetry client-side processing.
- [ADHD Test](https://adhdtest.vloam.com/): Evidence-based adult ADHD screening self-assessment tool with confidential in-browser scoring, comprehensive dimensional breakdown, and 10-language international support.
- [BPD Test](https://bdptest.vloam.com/): Clinically referenced Borderline Personality screening tool providing confidential evaluation, multi-factor analysis, and actionable educational summaries.
- [KinkTest](https://kinktest.vloam.com/): Private 12-dimension intimate preference and relationship dynamics quiz with client-side local scoring, couple comparison fit codes, and educational guidance on consent and aftercare.

## Engineering Essays & Architectural Notes

- [Why We Build Native in 2026: The Case for Zero-Cloud Local Computing](https://vloam.com/articles/why-we-build-native/): Architectural analysis on binary efficiency, memory overhead, OS secure enclave integration (macOS Keychain & Windows DPAPI), and why developer tools should not require a cloud account.
- [Zero-Knowledge Health Screening: Running Clinical Logic in Pure Browser Sandboxes](https://vloam.com/articles/zero-knowledge-screening/): How to implement evidence-based psychiatric self-assessment scales strictly client-side without databases, tracking pixels, or behavioral profiling.
